response: AIRING OUT A BOATHOUSE IS IMPORTANT FOR HEALTH AND COMFORT. IT HELPERS REMOVE STALE AIR AND PREVENT MOLD. THIS PROCESS ALSO PROMOTES GOOD VAPOR EXCHANGES AND KEEP THE SPACE CLEAN. IT IS BEST DONE BY OPENING ALL DOORS AND WINDOWS AND LETTING THE AIR CIRCULATE. THIS HELPERS STAYING VIBRANT AND PREVENTING DISEASE.
